title: Should You Buy Home Depot Stock Before the Huge Investor Update? | HD Stock Analysis
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions
summary: Parkevtate Vosianc asks whether Home Depot is a buying opportunity ahead of its 17 November investor update, calling it arguably the best home improvement retailer in the world in a roughly $1 trillion US industry. Growth has slowed sharply: Wall Street expects 8.3% EPS growth a year, well below the pre-pandemic pattern of about 8% revenue growth and roughly double that in EPS, because pandemic lockdowns pulled forward years of demand as people painted, renovated and added home offices. Margins have compressed with it: operating margin down from a peak of 15.5% to 12.4%, cash flow from operations to sales from about 17% to 11%, and return on invested capital from above 40% to 18.5%. Market share remains strong, especially with professional contractors, thanks to assortment and service. His DCF puts fair value at $272, and at 22 times forward earnings he sees more downside than upside and will not buy before results. Call: HD AVOID, flipped from BUY on 16 October. Bull: share strength with pro contractors. Bear: pulled-forward pandemic demand, tariffs and a muted housing market. No other tickers are called in the video.
